candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to return 502 and gateway checkout to fail with 502. Traces show payment 503 as the deepest error in each checkout chain; inventory/redis succeed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s trace to order returning 502, which traces to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory and redis succeed. Gateway itself is healthy (readyz 200). Bounded candidate is payment-side failure surfaced as http-500; payment internals unobserved, so confidence is moderate.
